# GrailShardPlan places whole classes on the gate's shards by these numbers
# (longest first, to the least-loaded shard, by time and -- where the KB
# column is there -- by memory); a class missing from here is costed by
# its test count, so nothing is ever dropped.

# (per run, the mean of a class's samples, so both arms count; across
# runs, the largest -- see the script for why).
# Third column, where measured: KB the class added to its shard's live
# memory (GRAIL_CLASS_MEM), the mean over runs; from CI run(s) 44387597520.
